en.s: The Battle of Forum Gallorum was fought on 14 April 43 BC between the forces of Mark Antony and legions loyal to the Roman Senate under the overall command of consul Gaius Pansa, aided by his fellow consul Aulus Hirtius. The untested Caesar Octavian (the future emperor Augustus) guarded the Senate's camp. The battle occurred on the Via Aemilia near a village in northern Italy, perhaps near modern-day Castelfranco Emilia.

zh.s: 福鲁姆·加洛鲁姆战役发生于公元前43年4月14日，交战双方是马克·安东尼的军队，以及忠于罗马元老院的军团。忠于元老院的部队由执政官盖乌斯·潘萨总指挥，另一位执政官奥卢斯·希尔提乌斯也参与作战。尚未证明军事才能的凯撒·屋大维（后来的奥古斯都皇帝）负责守卫元老院军营。战场位于埃米利亚大道附近的意大利北部一座村庄，可能靠近今天的卡斯泰尔弗兰科·艾米利亚。

en.s: The Battle of Bedriacum refers to two battles fought during the Year of the Four Emperors (AD 69) near the village of Bedriacum (now Calvatone), about 35 kilometers (22 mi) from the town of Cremona in northern Italy. The fighting in fact took place between Bedriacum and Cremona, and the battles are sometimes called "First Cremona" and "Second Cremona".

zh.t: 第一次贝德里亚库姆战役
zh.s: 69年4月14日，罗马帝国“四帝之年”争夺皇位的军队在贝德里亚库姆附近交战，奥托一方战败。“贝德里亚库姆战役”实际指当年在意大利北部两次交战：地点介于贝德里亚库姆（今卡尔瓦托内）与克雷莫纳之间，距后者约35公里，因此也称第一次和第二次克雷莫纳战役。

en.t: Otto II, Co-Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, marries Byzantine princess Theophanu. She is crowned empress by Pope John XIII in Rome the same day
en.s: The Holy Roman Empire, also known as the Holy Roman Empire of the German Nation after 1512, was a polity comprising and controlling much of Central Europe and Western Europe, headed by the Holy Roman Emperor and characterized by a decentralized political structure. It developed in the Early Middle Ages (beginning in either 800 or 962), and lasted for a millennium until its dissolution in 1806 during the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.t: 神圣罗马帝国共治皇帝奥托二世与拜占庭公主狄奥法努成婚；同日，她在罗马由教宗若望十三世加冕为皇后
zh.s: 神圣罗马帝国自1512年起也称德意志民族神圣罗马帝国，是一个涵盖并控制中欧和西欧大片地区的政体，由神圣罗马帝国皇帝统治，政治结构高度分散。帝国在中世纪早期形成（起始年份有800年或962年两种说法），延续约一千年，最终于1806年拿破仑战争期间解体。

en.s: The Battle of Haydaran (Arabic: معركة حيدران) or the Battle of Jabal Haydaran (Arabic: معركة جبل حيدران) was an armed conflict which took place on 14 April 1052 between the Arab tribes of Banu Hilal and the Zirid dynasty in modern-day South-East Tunisia, it was part of the Hilalian invasion of Ifriqiya.

zh.s: 海达兰之战又称海达兰山之战，于1052年4月14日在今突尼斯东南部发生，交战双方为阿拉伯希拉勒部族与齐里王朝，是希拉勒人入侵伊夫里基亚的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Adrianople occurred around Adrianople on April 14, 1205, between Bulgarians, Cumans and Vlachs under the command of Tsar Kaloyan of Bulgaria, and Crusaders under Baldwin I, who only months before had been crowned Emperor of Constantinople, allied with Venetians under Doge Enrico Dandolo. The battle was won by the Bulgarian Empire after a successful ambush.

zh.s: 1205年4月14日，保加利亚沙皇卡洛扬率领的保加利亚人、库曼人和弗拉赫人与十字军交战。十字军由鲍德温一世率领；他数月前刚加冕为君士坦丁堡皇帝。威尼斯人也加入十字军一方，由总督恩里科·丹多洛指挥。战役发生在阿德里安堡附近，保加利亚帝国通过成功伏击取得胜利。

en.s: The siege of Faenza was fought from late August 1240 until 14 April 1241 between the forces of Holy Roman Emperor Frederick II and the Guelph-controlled city of Faenza during the wars of the Guelphs and Ghibellines. One of the longest operations of Frederick's Italian campaigns, the siege ended in an Imperial victory after nearly eight months of blockade, bombardment and economic attrition.

zh.s: 法恩扎围城战发生于1240年8月下旬至1241年4月14日，交战双方是神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈二世的军队和由归尔甫派控制的法恩扎城。当时正值归尔甫派与吉伯林派战争。此次围城是腓特烈在意大利战役中持续时间最长的行动之一。经过近八个月的封锁、炮击和经济消耗后，帝国军获胜。

en.s: The 1336 battle of Tatarahama (多々良浜の戦い, Tatarahama no tatakai) was one of many battles constituting the Nanboku-chō Wars in Japan, in which two rival Imperial Courts battled for legitimacy and control of the country. It was decisive in securing control of the island of Kyūshū for the Northern Imperial Court, which was closely connected to the Ashikaga shogunate.

zh.s: 1336年的多多良滨之战（日语：多々良浜の戦い，Tatarahama no tatakai）是日本南北朝时代战争中的一场战斗。当时两个敌对朝廷争夺统治的合法性和国家控制权。此战对北朝夺取九州岛控制权起到决定性作用，北朝与足利幕府关系密切。

en.s: Black Monday took place on Easter Monday 1360, near the end of the Edwardian phase of the Hundred Years' War, when a freak hail storm struck and killed an estimated 1,000 English soldiers. The storm was so devastating that it caused more English casualties than any of the previous battles of the war.

en.s: The Battle of the Terek River was the last major battle of the Tokhtamysh–Timur war. It took place on 14 April 1395, at the Terek River, North Caucasus. The result was a victory for Timur.

en.s: The Yūki War (結城合戦, Yūki Kassen) was a 1440–1441 armed conflict in the Kantō region between the Uesugi clan (and by extension, the Ashikaga Shogunate) and powerful local families who had supported former Kamakura Kubō Ashikaga Mochiuji, most prominently the Yūki clan. It can be considered a continuation of the Eikyō Rebellion that had concluded a year earlier.

zh.s: 结城之战（日语：結城合戦，Yūki Kassen）是1440年至1441年在关东地区发生的一场武装冲突，交战双方是上杉氏（包括足利幕府）和支持前镰仓公方足利持氏的地方势力，其中结城氏尤为重要。此战可视为一年前结束的永享之乱的延续。

en.s: The Battle of Barnet was a decisive engagement in the Wars of the Roses, a dynastic conflict of 15th-century England. The military action, along with the subsequent Battle of Tewkesbury, secured the throne for Edward IV. On 14 April 1471 near Barnet, then a small Hertfordshire town north of London, Edward led the House of York in a fight against the House of Lancaster, which backed Henry VI for the throne. Leading the Lancastrian army was Richard Neville, 16th Earl of Warwick, who played a crucial role in the fate of each king.

zh.s: 巴尼特之战是15世纪英格兰王朝冲突玫瑰战争中的一场决定性战役。此战与随后发生的蒂克斯伯里之战，巩固了爱德华四世的王位。1471年4月14日，爱德华率领约克家族军队，在伦敦以北赫特福德郡小镇巴尼特附近，与拥立亨利六世的兰开斯特家族交战。兰开斯特军由第十六代沃里克伯爵理查德·内维尔率领，他曾对两位国王的命运都起过关键作用。

en.s: The Battle of Wurzach (German: Gefecht bei Wurzach or Schlacht am Leprosenberg), was a battle during the German Peasants' War that took place near Bad Wurzach in the present-day district of Ravensburg in Upper Swabia.

zh.s: 武尔扎赫战役（德语：Gefecht bei Wurzach或Schlacht am Leprosenberg）是德国农民战争期间在今上施瓦本拉文斯堡县巴特武尔扎赫附近发生的一场战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Ceresole (Italian pronunciation: [tʃereˈzɔːle]; also Cérisoles) took place on 14 April 1544, during the Italian War of 1542–1546, outside the village of Ceresole d'Alba in the Piedmont region of Italy. A French army, commanded by François de Bourbon, Count of Enghien, defeated the combined forces of the Holy Roman Empire and Spain, commanded by Alfonso d'Avalos d'Aquino, Marquis del Vasto.

zh.s: 切雷索莱之战于1544年4月14日在意大利皮埃蒙特地区切雷索莱达尔巴村外发生，属于1542年至1546年意大利战争。昂吉安伯爵弗朗索瓦·德·波旁率领法军，击败瓦斯托侯爵阿方索·达瓦洛斯·达基诺指挥的神圣罗马帝国与西班牙联军。

en.t: A celestial phenomenon is reported over Nuremberg, described as an aerial battle
en.s: In April 1561, a broadsheet by Hans Glaser described a mass sighting of celestial phenomena or unidentified flying objects (UFO) above Nuremberg (then a Free Imperial City of the Holy Roman Empire). Ufologists have speculated that contemporary observers may have witnessed extraterrestrial spacecraft. Skeptics assert that the incident was likely to have been an atmospheric event, such as a sun dog, although the print does not fit the usual classic description of the phenomenon.

zh.t: 纽伦堡上空出现不明天象
zh.s: 1561年4月14日，纽伦堡居民报告黎明时看到罕见天象，汉斯·格拉泽后来在传单中记述了这次集体目击事件。当时纽伦堡是神圣罗马帝国的自由城市。有人推测目击者看到了外星飞船；持怀疑态度者认为更可能是幻日等大气现象，但传单描述又与典型幻日不尽相符。

en.s: The Battle of Mookerheyde was a battle of the Eighty Years' War fought on 14 April 1574 near the village Mook and the river Meuse.In the winter months of on 1574, William the Silent's brothers, Louis and Henry of Nassau, raised a mercenary army in Germany of 6500 infantry and 3000 cavalry, and led them towards the city of Maastricht, where they were to meet the Prince of Orange named William the Silent who led 6000 Dutchmen himself. After that, they would join forces and march for the relief of Leiden which was besieged by a large Spanish force under the Duke of Alba.

zh.s: 穆克海德之战于1574年4月14日在穆克村与马斯河附近发生，是八十年战争中的一场战斗。1574年冬季，沉默者威廉的兄弟拿骚的路易与亨利，在德国招募了6500名步兵和3000名骑兵组成的雇佣军，率军前往马斯特里赫特。他们准备在那里与亲率6000名荷兰人的奥兰治亲王沉默者威廉会合，再共同进军，解救被阿尔瓦公爵麾下大批西班牙军队围困的莱顿。

en.s: The Battle of Sarhū (simplified Chinese: 萨尔浒之战; traditional Chinese: 薩爾滸之戰; pinyin: Sà'ěrhǔ zhī zhàn) refers to a series of battles between the Later Jin dynasty (the predecessor of the Qing dynasty) and the Ming dynasty and their Joseon allies in 1619. The battle is notable for the heavy use of cavalry by the Later Jin in defeating Ming and Joseon forces equipped with hand cannons, cannons, and matchlocks.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 萨尔浒之战（简体中文：萨尔浒之战；繁体中文：薩爾滸之戰；拼音：Sà'ěrhǔ zhī zhàn）是1619年后金（清朝的前身）与明朝及其朝鲜盟友之间一系列战役的统称。后金军大量使用骑兵，击败装备火铳、火炮和火绳枪的明朝及朝鲜军队，因此此战颇具代表性。

en.s: The Destruction of the Hindu temple of Koneswaram, at Trincomalee by the Portuguese governor of Ceylon, Constantino de Sá de Noronha took place in April 1622. At the time of the desecration, Koneswaram served as a Danish fortress.

zh.t: 葡萄牙军队摧毁科内斯瓦拉姆神庙
zh.s: 1622年4月14日，葡萄牙锡兰总督康斯坦蒂诺·德·萨·德·诺罗尼亚的军队，在今天斯里兰卡亭可马里袭击并摧毁科内斯瓦拉姆印度教神庙。当时神庙也充作丹麦人的堡垒；袭击发生在宗教游行期间，葡军夺走主神像、掠夺财物，并将庙宇推入海中。

en.s: The Battle of Amritsar was fought during Mukhlis Khan's campaign against Guru Hargobind and the Sikhs on 14 April 1634. The battle took place over two days and was a result of increasing tensions between the Mughal government and Guru Hargobind.

zh.s: 1634年4月14日，穆赫利斯·汗率军征讨古鲁·哈格宾德和锡克人，爆发阿姆利则战役。战斗持续两天，起因是莫卧儿政府与古鲁·哈格宾德之间的紧张关系不断升级。

en.s: The Battle of Chemnitz, 14 April 1639, took place near Chemnitz in Saxony during the Thirty Years' War. Swedish forces under Johan Banér inflicted a crushing defeat on a combined Saxon/Imperial detachment under Rodolfo Giovanni Marazzino and von Puchheim.

zh.s: 开姆尼茨之战于1639年4月14日在萨克森开姆尼茨附近发生，属于三十年战争。约翰·巴内尔指挥的瑞典军队，重创鲁道夫·乔万尼·马拉齐诺与冯·普赫海姆指挥的萨克森—帝国联军分遣队。

en.s: The siege of Alcántara was a siege between Allied and French forces in 1706, as part of the War of the Spanish Succession. Henri de Massue, Earl of Galway led a force of English and Portuguese troops to attack the French garrison at Alcántara. Part of James FitzJames, 1st Duke of Berwick's army was lost to the French.

en.s: The Yamasee War (also spelled Yamassee or Yemassee) was a conflict fought in South Carolina from 1715 to 1717 between British settlers from the Province of Carolina and the Yamasee, who were supported by a number of allied Native American peoples, including the Muscogee, Cherokee, Catawba, Apalachee, Apalachicola, Yuchi, Waccamaw, Savannah River Shawnee, Congaree, Waxhaw, Pee Dee, Cape Fear, Cheraw, and others.

zh.s: 亚马西战争又拼作Yamassee或Yemassee，是1715年至1717年在南卡罗来纳发生的一场冲突，交战双方是英国殖民者和亚马西人。亚马西人得到多个美洲原住民群体支持，包括马斯科吉人、切罗基人、卡托巴人、阿巴拉契人、阿巴拉奇科拉人、尤奇人、瓦卡莫人、萨凡纳河肖尼人、康加里人、瓦克肖人、皮迪人、开普菲尔人、切罗人等。

en.s: The Battle of Monck's Corner was fought on April 14, 1780, outside of Charleston, South Carolina, which was under siege by British forces under the command of General Sir Henry Clinton in the American Revolutionary War. The British Legion, under the command of Lieutenant Colonel Banastre Tarleton, surprised a Patriot force stationed at Monck's Corner and drove them away.

en.s: The Battle of Millesimo, fought on 13 and 14 April 1796, was the name that Napoleon Bonaparte gave in his correspondence to one of a series of small battles that were fought in Liguria, Northern Italy between the armies of France and the allied armies of Austria and of the Kingdom of Sardinia-Piedmont.

en.s: The 1796 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 14, 1796, in order to elect the Governor of Connecticut. Incumbent Federalist Acting Governor Oliver Wolcott won a plurality of the vote in his election bid against other candidates. However, as no candidate received a majority of the total votes cast as was required by Connecticut law, the election was forwarded to the Connecticut legislature, who chose Wolcott as governor.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1796年4月14日举行州长选举。现任联邦党代理州长奥利弗·沃尔科特在与其他候选人的竞争中得票最多，但无人达到州法律要求的过半票数，因此选举交由州议会决定。州议会选择沃尔科特担任州长。

en.s: The Battle of Bayonne of 14 April 1814 was a sortie by General Thouvenot's French garrison of Bayonne during the siege of that city conducted by Allied forces under Lieutenant General John Hope. The battle was the last of the Peninsular War and occurred as news of Napoleon's abdication was beginning to reach the opposing forces. While the Siege of Bayonne was largely illusory, with French and British soldiers fraternizing and exchanging goods and letters, the fighting of 14 April involved heavy hand-to-hand combat in which Lieut-Gen Hope was captured with two of his staff, 276 men and a gun, before reinforcements stabilized the Allied positions.

zh.s: 1814年4月14日的巴约讷之战，是图弗诺将军率领法军守军从巴约讷城内发动的一次突围战。该城当时正遭约翰·霍普中将率领的联军围困。这是半岛战争的最后一场战斗，发生时拿破仑退位的消息正开始传到交战双方。巴约讷的围城原本很大程度上只是形式，法国与英国士兵甚至友好往来，交换物品和信件，但4月14日却爆发了激烈的肉搏战。霍普中将、两名参谋及276名官兵被俘，一门炮被缴获，直到援军抵达才稳住联军阵地。

en.s: Bussa's rebellion (14–16 April 1816) was the largest slave revolt in Barbadian history. The rebellion takes its name from the African-born slave, Bussa, who led the rebellion which was defeated by British forces. Bussa's Rebellion was the first of three large-scale slave rebellions in the British West Indies that shook public faith in slavery in the years leading up to the abolition of slavery in the British Empire and emancipation of former slaves. It was followed by the large-scale rebellion in Demerara in 1823 and by an even larger rebellion in Jamaica in 1831–32. Collectively these are often referred to as the "late slave rebellions".

zh.s: 1816年4月14日至16日的布萨起义，是巴巴多斯历史上规模最大的奴隶起义。起义因其领袖、出生于非洲的奴隶布萨而得名，最终被英军镇压。在大英帝国废除奴隶制、解放奴隶之前，英属西印度群岛发生了三次大规模奴隶起义，动摇了公众对奴隶制的认同，布萨起义是其中第一次。其后还有1823年的德梅拉拉大起义，以及规模更大的1831年至1832年牙买加起义。这三次事件常被合称为“晚期奴隶起义”。

en.s: The first 1831 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 14. National Republican Governor Levi Lincoln Jr. was re-elected to a seventh term in office over Democrat Marcus Morton. This was the final regular Massachusetts election scheduled for April before the schedule changed to November, where it remains as of 2026. Lincoln was elected to a reduced term of eight months expiring in January, instead of the typical year-long term ending in May.

zh.s: 1831年4月14日，马萨诸塞州举行当年的第一次州长选举。国家共和党籍时任州长利瓦伊·林肯二世击败民主党候选人马库斯·莫顿，连任第七届。这是马萨诸塞州最后一次安排在4月举行的常规州选举；之后改为11月举行，此后一直如此。林肯这次当选后任期缩短为八个月，至次年1月结束，而非通常到5月届满的一年任期。

en.s: The Hungarian Declaration of Independence declared the independence of Hungary from the Habsburg monarchy during the Hungarian Revolution of 1848. The declaration of Hungarian independence was made possible by the positive mood created by the military successes of the Spring Campaign. It was presented to the National Assembly in closed session on 13 April 1849 by Lajos Kossuth, and in open session the following day, despite political opposition from within the Hungarian Peace Party.

zh.s: 匈牙利独立宣言在1848年匈牙利革命期间宣布脱离哈布斯堡君主国独立。春季战役取得的军事胜利带来有利形势，为发表宣言创造了条件。1849年4月13日，拉约什·科苏特在闭门会议上向国民议会提交宣言；尽管匈牙利和平党内部有人反对，次日仍在公开会议上宣布独立。

en.s: The battle of Rangoon was fought between 11 and 14 April 1852 over the city of Rangoon (present-day Yangon), capital of the Third Burmese Empire, as one of the crucial clashes during the Second Anglo-Burmese War between 1852 and 1853. Just after a few days after sparking the conflict British expeditionary troops took control over the city and forced the Burmese army to retreat up north.

zh.s: 仰光之战于1852年4月11日至14日围绕第三缅甸帝国首都仰光展开，是1852年至1853年第二次英缅战争中的关键战役之一。冲突爆发仅几天后，英国远征军便控制了仰光，迫使缅甸军队向北撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Buda Zaborowska, one of many skirmishes of the January Uprising, took place on April 14, 1863, near the village of Buda Zaborowska in central part of Russian-controlled Congress Poland. Polish forces under Major Walery Remiszewski clashed with troops of the Imperial Russian Army. The battle resulted in Russian victory. In January 1863, a number of teenagers from Warsaw fled to the Kampinos Forest, in order to escape draft to the Russian Army. On January 17, Zygmunt Padlewski from Warsaw came to Kampinos, and in the following days, he organized a 1000-strong unit of teenagers, young men and local peasants, some of whom were armed only with sticks.

zh.t: 布达扎博罗夫斯卡之战
zh.s: 布达扎博罗夫斯卡之战是波兰一月起义期间的多次小规模战斗之一，于1863年4月14日在俄国控制的波兰会议王国中部、布达扎博罗夫斯卡村附近发生。瓦莱里·雷米舍夫斯基少校率领波兰部队，与俄罗斯帝国军队交战，俄军获胜。1863年1月，一批华沙少年为逃避俄军征兵，逃入坎皮诺斯森林。1月17日，齐格蒙特·帕德莱夫斯基从华沙来到坎皮诺斯，并在随后几天将少年、青年和当地农民组织成一支1000人的队伍，其中一些人只有木棍作为武器。

en.s: The Battle of Irish Bend, also known as Nerson's Woods or Franklin, took place during the American Civil War. It was fought between Union Major General Nathaniel Prentice Banks against Confederate Major General Richard Taylor during Banks's operations against the Bayou Teche region near Franklin, the seat of St. Mary Parish in southern Louisiana.

zh.s: 爱尔兰湾战役又称尼尔森树林战役或富兰克林战役，是美国内战期间的一场战斗。联邦军少将纳撒尼尔·普伦蒂斯·班克斯与邦联军少将理查德·泰勒在路易斯安那州南部圣玛丽教区首府富兰克林附近交战。当时，班克斯正在特什河地区开展军事行动。

en.s: On April 14, 1865, Abraham Lincoln, the 16th president of the United States, was shot at Ford's Theatre in Washington, D.C., and died the next day, one month into his second term and towards the conclusion of the American Civil War. Lincoln was watching the play Our American Cousin with his wife Mary Todd, Major Henry Rathbone, and Rathbone's fiancé Clara Harris when John Wilkes Booth, an actor and Confederate sympathizer, shot him in the head.

zh.s: 1865年4月14日，美国第16任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯在华盛顿特区福特剧院遭枪击，次日去世。当时他开始第二个任期仅一个月，美国内战也接近尾声。林肯正与妻子玛丽·托德、亨利·拉思伯恩少校及拉思伯恩的未婚妻克拉拉·哈里斯观看戏剧《我们的美国表亲》，演员、邦联支持者约翰·威尔克斯·布斯向他头部开枪。

en.s: The Organization of American States (OAS or OEA; Spanish: Organización de los Estados Americanos; Portuguese: Organização dos Estados Americanos; French: Organisation des États américains) is an international organization founded on 30 April 1948 to promote cooperation among its member states within the Americas. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., United States, the OAS is a voluntary "multilateral regional body focused on human rights, electoral oversight, social and economic development, and security in the Western Hemisphere", according to the Council on Foreign Relations.

zh.s: 美洲国家组织（OAS或OEA；西班牙语：Organización de los Estados Americanos；葡萄牙语：Organização dos Estados Americanos；法语：Organisation des États américains）是一个国际组织，成立于1948年4月30日，旨在促进美洲成员国之间的合作。总部位于美国华盛顿特区。根据外交关系委员会的说法，这是一个自愿组成的“多边区域组织，关注西半球的人权、选举监督、社会和经济发展及安全”。

en.s: The Exposition Universelle of 1900 (French pronunciation: [ɛkspozisjɔ̃ ynivɛʁsɛl]), better known in English as the 1900 Paris Exposition, was a world's fair held in Paris, France, from 14 April to 12 November 1900, to celebrate the achievements of the past century and to accelerate development into the next. en.s: The 1929 Monaco Grand Prix was the first Grand Prix to be run in the Principality. en.s: The Spanish Republic (Spanish: República Española), commonly known as the Second Spanish Republic (Spanish: Segunda República Española), was the democratic government of Spain from 1931 to 1939. zh.t: 第二西班牙共和国宣告成立
zh.s: 西班牙共和国（西班牙语：República Española），通常称为第二西班牙共和国（西班牙语：Segunda República Española），是1931年至1939年西班牙的民主政权。阿方索十三世国王被废黜后，共和国于1931年4月14日宣告成立。1939年4月1日，该政权在西班牙内战中被弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥将军领导的国民军击败并投降后解散。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Venezuela on 14 April 2013 following the death of President Hugo Chávez on 5 March 2013. Voters gave Nicolás Maduro—who had assumed the role of acting president since Chávez's death—a narrow victory over his opponent Henrique Capriles Radonski, the Governor of Miranda. Capriles had run in the previous election less than a year before, losing to Chávez by an 11-point margin. This time the margin of victory was much smaller (being 1.49%), and thus became the closest Presidential Election of the country since the 1968 election.

zh.s: 总统乌戈·查韦斯于2013年3月5日去世后，委内瑞拉于4月14日举行总统选举。查韦斯去世后担任代总统的尼古拉斯·马杜罗，以微弱优势击败米兰达州州长恩里克·卡普里莱斯·拉东斯基。不到一年前，卡普里莱斯曾参加上一次总统选举，以11个百分点之差败给查韦斯。这次双方差距缩小至1.49个百分点，成为该国自1968年以来结果最接近的总统选举。

en.s: European Parliament elections were held in Croatia for the first time on 14 April 2013 to elect twelve Members of the European Parliament. The members served the remainder of the Parliament's 2009–2014 term after Croatia entered the European Union on 1 July 2013. The country formed a single constituency, with members elected by proportional representation using open lists.

zh.s: 克罗地亚于2013年4月14日首次举行欧洲议会选举，选出12名欧洲议会议员。他们在克罗地亚于7月1日加入欧盟后，履行欧洲议会2009年至2014年届期的剩余任期。全国作为一个选区，以开放式政党名单的比例代表制选出议员。

en.t: 2013 Liberal Party of Canada leadership election
en.s: In 2013, the Liberal Party of Canada held a leadership election to elect a new party leader. The election was triggered by Michael Ignatieff's announcement, on May 3, 2011, of his intention to resign as leader following the party's defeat in the 2011 federal election. On May 25, 2011, Bob Rae was appointed by Liberal caucus as interim leader.

zh.t: 特鲁多当选加拿大自由党领袖
zh.s: 2013年4月14日，加拿大自由党选出贾斯廷·特鲁多为新党领袖。这次选举缘于迈克尔·伊格纳季耶夫在2011年联邦大选失利后，于当年5月3日表示将辞职；2011年5月25日，党团任命鲍勃·雷为临时领袖。

en.s: On 14 April 2014 at about 6:45am, two bombs exploded at a crowded bus station in Nyanya, Nasarawa, killing at least 88 people and injuring at least 200. The bus station is 8 km southwest of central Federal Capital Territory. Boko Haram claimed responsibility for the bombing six days after it occurred.

zh.s: 2014年4月14日早晨约6时45分，纳萨拉瓦尼亚尼亚一座拥挤的公交车站内发生两起炸弹爆炸，造成至少88人死亡、至少200人受伤。该车站位于联邦首都区中心西南8公里处。博科圣地在袭击发生六天后宣布负责。

en.s: The Battle of Hit, code named Operation Desert Lynx by Iraqi forces, was an offensive launched by the Iraqi Government during the Anbar offensive, with the goal of recapturing the town of Hīt and the Hīt District from ISIL. After the Iraqi forces recaptured the city of Ramadi, Hīt and Fallujah were the only cities still under the control of ISIL in the Al Anbar Governorate. Iraqi Forces fully recaptured Hīt and the rest of the Hīt District on 14 April 2016.

zh.s: 希特之战是伊拉克政府在安巴尔攻势期间发动的进攻，伊军将其代号定为“沙漠猞猁行动”，目标是从“伊斯兰国”手中夺回希特镇及希特区。伊拉克部队收复拉马迪后，安巴尔省仅有希特和费卢杰两座城市仍由“伊斯兰国”控制。2016年4月14日，伊军完全收复希特及该区其余地区。

en.s: The Battle of Tipo-Tipo was a military engagement that began on 9 April 2016 at Tipo-Tipo, Basilan Island, Philippines between forces of the Philippine Army and members of the Abu Sayyaf militant group. The battle resulted in dozens of casualties, with at least 18 soldiers and 31 militants reported killed, and more than 70 others injured.

en.t: The foreshock of a major earthquake occurs in Kumamoto, Japan
en.s: The 2016 Kumamoto earthquakes (Japanese: 平成28年熊本地震, Hepburn: Heisei 28-nen Kumamoto jishin) were a series of earthquakes, including a magnitude 7.0 mainshock which struck at 01:25 JST on April 16, 2016 (16:25 UTC on April 15) beneath Kumamoto City of Kumamoto Prefecture in Kyushu Region, Japan, at a depth of about 10 kilometres (6.2 miles), and a foreshock earthquake with a magnitude 6.2 at 21:26 JST (12:26 UTC) on April 14, 2016, at a depth of about 11 kilometres (6.8 miles).

zh.s: 2016年熊本地震是一系列地震，其中主震矩震级7.0级，于2016年4月16日日本标准时间1时25分（4月15日协调世界时16时25分）在九州熊本县熊本市下方约10公里（6.2英里）深处发生；此前于4月14日日本标准时间21时26分（协调世界时12时26分）发生了6.2级前震，震源深度约11公里（6.8英里）。

en.s: La Copa Junior Nuevos Valores (2017) (Spanish for "The New Values Junior Cup") was a professional wrestling tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council"). The tournament ran from April 14, 2017 to April 28, 2017 in Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. CMLL's recurring La Copa Junior tournament featured second, third or fourth generation wrestlers completing against each other.

zh.s: 2017年摔角后代新秀杯，名称原意为“新生力量后代杯”，是墨西哥世界摔角理事会（CMLL）制作并编排剧情的一项职业摔角锦标赛。比赛于2017年4月14日至28日在墨西哥城的墨西哥体育馆举行。CMLL定期举办的摔角后代杯，由第二代、第三代或第四代摔角手相互较量。

en.s: The Rif Dimashq offensive (February–April 2018), code-named Operation Damascus Steel, was a military offensive launched by the Syrian Arab Army (SAA) in February 2018 in a bid to capture the rebel-held eastern Ghouta suburb during the Syrian civil war. East Ghouta, a pocket of towns and farms, had been under government siege since 2013 and had been a major rebel stronghold in the vicinity of the capital of Damascus.

zh.s: 里夫迪马什克攻势代号“钢铁大马士革行动”，是叙利亚阿拉伯军于2018年2月发动的一场军事攻势，意在从反政府武装手中夺取东古塔郊区。叙利亚内战期间，东古塔由一片城镇和农田组成，自2013年起一直遭政府军围困，并成为首都大马士革附近的重要反政府武装据点。

en.s: On 14 April 2018, beginning at 04:00 Syrian time (UTC+3), the United States, France, and the United Kingdom carried out a series of military strikes involving aircraft and ship-based missiles against multiple government sites in Syria during the Syrian Civil War. The strikes were a reprisal for the Douma chemical attack against civilians on 7 April, widely attributed to the Syrian government.

zh.s: 2018年4月14日叙利亚时间凌晨4时（协调世界时+3）起，美国、法国和英国在叙利亚内战期间发动一系列军事打击，使用飞机和舰载导弹袭击叙利亚多个政府目标。此次袭击是对4月7日杜马化学武器袭击平民事件的报复，该事件普遍被归咎于叙利亚政府。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Finland on 14 April 2019. For the first time, no party received more than 20% of the vote. The Centre Party, which had been the largest party following the 2015 elections, dropped to fourth place, losing 18 seats and recording its lowest vote share since 1917. The Social Democratic Party saw the biggest gains, winning six more seats and narrowly becoming the largest party for the first time since 1999.

zh.s: 芬兰于2019年4月14日举行议会选举，首次没有任何政党获得超过20%的选票。2015年选举后成为第一大党的中间党失去18席，跌至第四位，得票率降至1917年以来最低。社会民主党进步最大，增加六席，并以微弱优势成为第一大党，这是该党自1999年以来首次位居第一。

en.t: The Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer (JUICE) is launched by the European Space Agency
en.s: The Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer (Juice, formerly JUICE) is an interplanetary spacecraft developed by the European Space Agency (ESA). It is on its way to orbit and study three icy moons of Jupiter: Ganymede, Callisto, and Europa. These planetary-mass moons are targets for study because they are thought to have significant bodies of liquid water beneath their frozen surfaces, which would make them potentially habitable for extraterrestrial life.

zh.t: 欧洲航天局发射木星冰卫星探测器（Juice）
zh.s: 木星冰卫星探测器（Juice；该任务此前称为JUICE）是欧洲航天局研制的星际探测器，正在前往木星，计划环绕并研究木卫三、木卫四和木卫二。这些木星卫星可能在冰层下拥有大量液态水，因此被列为寻找地外宜居环境的研究目标。

en.t: Flooding in the Persian Gulf starts, killing 19 in Oman
en.s: In April 2024 heavy rain severely impacted states in the Persian Gulf, causing flash flooding across the region. Several states recorded nearly a year's worth of rain in a single day. The floods had a significant impact across the region, with Oman and the United Arab Emirates being particularly affected, resulting in the deaths of at least 46 people, including 20 in Oman, and 18 in Iran.

zh.t: 波斯湾地区开始发生洪灾，阿曼有19人死亡
zh.s: 2024年4月，强降雨严重影响波斯湾沿岸国家，引发全区山洪暴发。多个国家单日降雨量接近全年总量。洪灾对该地区造成重大影响，阿曼和阿拉伯联合酋长国受灾尤为严重；至少46人死亡，其中阿曼20人、伊朗18人。
